## Summary

A short, single-sentence description of what is broken.

## Environment

- Branch / commit: `<branch>@<sha>` (paste `git rev-parse HEAD` output)
- Deploy: local dev (loopback) / Coolify (remote reviewer)
- App URL: `http://127.0.0.1:8778` (local) or `https://ocr.dobbinscodex.cloud` (deployed)
- Reviewer session: `REVIEWER=<alden|jeff>`, single- or multi-user
- Browser + OS, if UI-shaped

1.
2.
3.

## Expected behaviour

What should have happened, step by step.

## Actual behaviour

What did happen instead. Quote the exact error message or the on-screen state.

## Logs / screenshots

Attach anything that is not in the prose — terminal output, server logs,
browser console. Redact credentials before pasting.

## Impact

How many documents / pages / reviewers are affected. Whether the bug blocks
a review session or is just a papercut.

## Possible cause

Optional. If you have a hunch, say so — a wrong guess is better than no
guess, because it steers the reproducer.
